TEXT: There was a strangely awkward mood between us.

It was probably due to what Kanako had said 
yesterday.

If it were me of the past, I would have probably 
decided that "She's in a bad mood" and left it at 
that.

But now, what's on her mind... I couldn't just 
arbitrarily determine that.

I'm at a loss too, I have no idea how I should 
interact with her.

This state of affairs was all thanks to Kanako's 
outside interference...
The awkward situation continued for several days.

TEXT: Where are you going out to?

TEXT:
......N-Nowhere in particular. It has nothing to do with 
you.

Instead, I gave a timid response.
After dinner, I relaxed in the living room and...
Kirino tried to say something, but.
